answer: Quadratic staking is a concrete Sybil defense: before an agent can vote or earn, it locks a bond whose size grows with the square of the identities it claims. One honest account costs little; ten forged ones cost a hundred times as much. Think of a glacier of committed capital: one marble of stake will not span it, only a real bridge of funds will. Slashing burns the bond on fraud, so the attacker pays for every fake identity up front and forfeits all of it when caught.
